caseNameFull: WASMUTH v. ALLEN, COMMISSIONER OF EDUCATION OF NEW YORK
attorneys: C. Dickerman Williams for appellants., Louis J. Lejkowitz, Attorney General of New York, and Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
